summary: Executed mixed backend/frontend M1 acceptance regression. Offline contract suites largely pass, but critical runtime defects remain: auth/login hangs for non-browser clients and UI sign-in often stalls at 'Signing in…'; descriptor-contract module has import-time failure blocking declaration flow confidence.

critical.issue: descriptor_contracts cannot import (`ImportError: cannot import name 'sources_for' from operational_scope`), indicating broken runtime path for connection descriptor declaration.
Direct HTTP clients (curl/requests) repeatedly time out waiting for response body despite backend access logs showing HTTP 200; this aligns with UI login spinner never clearing in several runs.

ui_bugs.issue: Submit remains stuck at 'Signing in…' for >12s with no surfaced error; user cannot proceed to registry/census screens reliably.
When history view was reachable, owner-required detail taxonomy remained absent (exact tabs and Coverage/Condition/Readiness grouped rows not observed).

integration_issues.flow: Operator sign-in to authenticated census overview
integration_issues.issue: Intermittent auth/session progression failure: backend logs show login 200, but frontend remains unauthenticated/sign-in-required state.

issues: Exact owner census-detail labels/sections were not confirmed in this run due blocked auth progression.
Desktop/mobile shell shows no overflow in captured smoke frames, but acceptance fidelity remains unproven.

action_items: Fix `services/census_autonomy/descriptor_contracts.py` import dependency (`sources_for`) or restore compatibility in `operational_scope.py`; then retest `/api/portal/census/connections` declaration/idempotency path.
Root-cause auth response hang (likely response-body completion/session propagation issue) so login resolves for both browser and HTTP clients; verify spinner clears and protected data loads.

After auth stabilization, rerun full owner UX fidelity checks: exact four detail tabs, all 13 rows under Coverage/Condition/Readiness, historical census #4 truth states, Source/Connect/Compute/Models flows.
critical_code_review_comments: `descriptor_contracts.py` imports `sources_for`, but `operational_scope.py` currently exposes `tenant_from_account` and `validate_submission` only; this is a hard runtime contract break.

Frontend login state machine in `CensusAccess.jsx` depends on `login()` promise resolution; observed stuck busy state plus HTTP-client timeouts indicate backend/auth transport completion problem, not merely selector/test instability.
`test_live_api_contract.py` still uses `BASE_URL = os.environ.get(..., '')` default pattern (empty fallback) contrary to strict no-default env rule; keep env-fail-fast semantics for reliability.

success_rate.backend: 87% (26 pass, 1 fail, 3 skip on offline/contract suite; live API suite skipped due repeated login timeout from requests client)
success_rate.frontend: 30% (shell load + screenshots pass; auth-gated deep flows blocked)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login behavior is inconsistent: backend logs repeatedly show POST /api/auth/login 200, yet UI often remains stuck on sign-in form with 'Signing in…' and no error. Requests/curl from test client timed out awaiting login response body. One hard backend code defect reproduced via pytest: descriptor_contracts import failure on missing `sources_for`. Offline durability tests (registry_durability restore integrity/writeback) passed.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (backend contract break): `descriptor_contracts.py` statically imports `sources_for` from `operational_scope.py`, but symbol is absent -> import-time crash and likely 500 when connection descriptor flow loads. Repro: run `pytest backend/tests/census_operational/test_registry_contracts_iteration56.py::test_r00_descriptor_contracts_module_imports`. Mitigation: restore/export `sources_for` or refactor descriptor module to use existing tenant/source gate API. RCA-2 (auth hang): non-browser HTTP login calls stall until timeout while UI button remains busy, indicating unresolved response/promise chain despite logged 200 status. Repro: curl/login command with 20s timeout and Playwright sign-in loop. Mitigation: inspect auth endpoint response write/flush path and frontend login fetch lifecycle; confirm complete JSON body delivery and token storage/event dispatch completion.
